fixed_denominators.note: planned denominators; the campaign controller ends a campaign at the first failed trial (campaign_base raises StepFailed on an application, switch or standards failure), so the reported denominator is the trials actually run, with the failure reported as found

denominator_rule: matrix.prepare: arms x trials x (reads_per_trial + SELECT + OPERATE) = 1 x 4 x 128 per D

order: logical request transactions of the captured master stream (TCP first-arrival reassembly from the
single SYN, then DNP3 link/transport reassembly) are [READ mixed, SELECT, OPERATE, READ integrity]
x 32 per trial; the master records are the same transactions byte for byte
responses: one response transaction per request, bound by stream order and TCP acknowledgement (never by the
application-sequence nibble alone), complete and successful from the captured bytes: READ mixed 141
and integrity 158 octets with their class objects, SELECT and OPERATE 60 octets with CROB SUCCESS on
points 1 and 3 and the request echoed
loss_and_retransmission: reported separately per trial and direction: TCP retransmitted segments and bytes (relay_check
accounting), missing planned exchanges, capture drops, master transactions that are not OK
observable.application_failures: CROB status other than SUCCESS, wrong READ class or size, failed decode
timing: against the current contract (response-ready ACK, then release after the configured D); CLRT
measured at the master NIC and reported by class (relay_check.visible_clrt); no precision criterion
switch_state_after_trial: existing counter checks: T on, generator triggers = READ + SELECT + OPERATE = 128 per trial with
2k packets per trigger, retired app1 idle, loop-port octet gaps zero
observable.restoration: per-trial teardown and the block verified production restoration (restore_verify)

workload: relay_master.workload(strict_cycle=True) runs the SBO before each odd-index READ. The previous
order (SBO before READs 1..N) gave mixed,S,O,integrity,S,O,mixed,integrity in a stub run and still
passed on counts, so no retained c72 run exercised this alternation under a strict gate
switch: source findings at fb5ce81b1: busy_t sends READ/SELECT/OPERATE to busy_drop while N holds its single
work cell, and a late handshake ACK can take the first_event default and the abort path; the strict
cycle puts each OPERATE right after its padded SELECT response and each integrity READ right after
the OPERATE response, at D = 20 and 5 ms with timing and padding on
relay: IEEE 1815 select-before-operate: the OPERATE must match its SELECT within the select timeout
(manual default 1.0 s, relay setting not read)

falsifier: any trial whose captured request transactions are not the strict order, or whose master records differ
any request without exactly one bound, complete and successful response of the arm image size
any unexpected drop: a missing planned exchange, a capture drop, or a master transaction that is not OK
stale T/N state reported by the existing switch checks
retransmission_rule: a TCP retransmission of delivered bytes is one transaction and does not fail the order gate; it is
reported as loss evidence. A repeated application request (new stream bytes) is a transaction
verdict_path: campaign.CandidateCampaign.relay_verdict: relay_check.analyze(strict_cycle=True, images of the padded
arm) with planned READ 64, SELECT 32, OPERATE 32; standards.validate_standards with expected.strict_cycle;
checker_identity: relay_master.py, checks.py, relay_check.py and standards.py are in the relay-checker hash closure, so
future runs get a new checker identity; retained verdicts replay with scripts/analysis/replay_frozen.py
extraction: not part of this registration; eval_rows.py and its c72-pinned 65/64/64 shape are not used
interpretation_limits: Eight trials (1,024 exchanges) are a bounded baseline on c72, not a rate estimate and not a fix.
Master-NIC captures do not observe the relay-facing link, switch emission or departure timing.
Only the combined arm at D = 20 and 5 ms is covered.
The relay select timeout stays unverified.
stop_rules: unsafe ownership or unverified restoration stops all writes
no rerun-until-pass, no extra trials or blocks
a failed trial stays FAIL and is reported as found
a failed trial ends its campaign; the trials not run are reported as not run, not as passed
